rationale: M37.13 follow-up wave-2 gate fixture (php dual-lens #606, PHPD11): PHP 8 nullsafe member READS must emit uses exactly like the non-null form. `$this->svc->name` parses as member_access_expression with a "name" field; `$this->svc?->name` parses as nullsafe_member_access_expression with the SAME "name" field (probe-verified 2026-09-07), but the walkBody member-read branch only matched member_access_expression, so every nullsafe read silently dropped the trailing member edge. 20 occurrences across phpunit+phpmyadmin+slim (4,231 files), differential-invisible because the oracle shared the shallow gate. Writes (`$this->feature?->name = $v`) and RMW (`$this->feature?->name .= '!'`) stay gated exactly like the plain form via the byte-range first-child rule. The receiver reads (feature/nested) are real member reads on both sides (csharp/java/ruby family precedent: the container is fetched to dereference).
